_meta.note: Source-language catalog. Interface strings only: authoritative agricultural text lives in the knowledge base with its own review state.

common.error_generic: That information could not be loaded.
common.insufficient_real_data: There is not enough verified information for this request.

knowledge.ask_unavailable_hint: AGRIQ only answers from review-verified, sourced records. For this question nothing verified is available yet.
knowledge.awaiting_review: {count} entry/entries are waiting for review and are not shown as verified knowledge.
knowledge.empty_category: No verified entry has been reviewed for this category yet.
knowledge.empty_category_hint: Entries appear here only after a source-backed record passes review. Nothing is written for display purposes.
knowledge.freshness_current: This record is inside its review window.
knowledge.freshness_due: This record is due for re-verification.
knowledge.freshness_expired: This record passed its review date and is not presented as current.
knowledge.mode_hint: Both views use the same verified source records.
knowledge.no_results_hint: Try another crop, region or keyword. AGRIQ never invents a result to fill this space.
knowledge.region_notice: This practice is documented for the region named above. Do not treat it as universally applicable.
knowledge.search_placeholder: For example: rice, tomato, mulching, drip irrigation, neem, pest management
knowledge.subtitle: Ancient, traditional and modern practices, organic and biological pest management, and modern pesticide information — every entry traced to a real source.
knowledge.title: Farming Techniques

farmer.suitability: Is it suitable for my crop?
farmer.not_a_recommendation: This is verified knowledge, not a field-specific recommendation. AGRIQ does not recommend a technique automatically just because it exists here.

student.evidence_note: Where a claim is historical or traditional it is labelled as such and is not presented as a modern scientific recommendation.
student.not_a_recommendation: Study material drawn from the sources listed below. It is not a field prescription.

pesticide.label_notice: Always follow the current official product label and your local agricultural authority's guidance. This page is information about an approved product; it is not a substitute for the label.
pesticide.application_unverified_note: Exact dose, spray volume and interval for this product and crop could not be verified from a current authoritative source for this entry, so AGRIQ states none. Read the official label or ask your KVK/agriculture officer.
pesticide.manufacturing_refusal: AGRIQ does not provide instructions for manufacturing, synthesising or formulating pesticides. Only approved products with official labels are described here.
pesticide.no_manufacturing: Manufacturing, synthesis and formulation instructions are not provided.

knowledge_states.PREPARATION_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: No credible source documents a preparation or formulation for this practice, so AGRIQ states none.
knowledge_states.APPLICATION_DATA_UNVERIFIED: The application details for this entry could not be verified against a current authoritative source.
knowledge_states.INSUFFICIENT_REAL_DATA: There is not enough verified information for this request.
knowledge_states.TRANSLATION_PENDING_REVIEW: This language is an AGRIQ draft translation and has not been reviewed by a native-speaking agricultural reviewer yet.
knowledge_states.TRANSLATION_UNAVAILABLE: This content has not been translated. The source-language text is shown.
knowledge_states.SOURCE_LANGUAGE_SHOWN: Showing the source-language text because no reviewed translation exists for this language.
knowledge_states.STALE_SOURCE: The source for this entry needs re-verification.

language_notice.draft: Odia and Hindi interface text on AGRIQ is a reviewed-in-progress draft. Authoritative agricultural text is always shown in its source language with the English original.

js.pesticide_notice: Follow the official product label. AGRIQ does not provide dosage or manufacturing information.
